texts.facts: The case of the prosecution, as appears from the record, is to the effect that on 14.09.1991 at about 08:00 AM altercation took place between the parties. As per written report dated 14.09.1991, accused were Shiv Mohan, Brij Mohan, sons of Ram Lal, Om Prkash S/o Shiv Mohan, Ram Udit S/o Ram Sahay and Hari Lal S/o Durga Prasad, Vishwanath S/o Dukhi, Shiv Shankar S/o Ram Piyare, resident of Saraiya, Shahgarh, P.S.-Munshiganj, District-Sultanpur, Ram Asarey S/o Bechayi, resident of Village-Bodhi Bisen Ka Purwa, Shahgarh, P.S.-Munshiganj, District-Sultanpur, Ram Kishun and Ram Sukh, sons of Khandi, resident of Village-Baidouliya, Majre Purab Gaon, Shahgarh, P.S.-Munshiganj, District-Sultanpur and all these persons armed with 'Pharsa', 'Lathi' came at the door (place of crime) of Informant/Ram Dulare S/o Baijnath, resident of Saraiya, Shahgarh, P.S.-Munshiganj, District-Sultanpur and accused-Shiv Mohan caused injury with 'Pharsa' to Rampher, uncle of the informant. The incident occurred on account of the fact that the informant-Ram Dularey opposed the construction of 'Sariya' of Shiv Mohan, which was over village road situated in front of house of informant-Ram Dularey and which was an obstruction in laying down Kharanja. 4. According to the written report dated 14.09.1991, Nankau, real brother of informant, Ram Sukh, cousin of informant, Ram Roop, nephew of the informant, Jaiprakash, who rushed to spot to interfere in the matter, assaulted with 'Lathi' and one Uma Shankar, who also rushed to spot, was assaulted with 'Pharsa' by Shiv Mohan and he was also assaulted with 'Lathi' by others. 5. It also appears from the written report dated 14.09.1991 that when Ram Sumer, Ram Sundar, Jagdeesh and others of the same village rushed to the spot, accused-appellants fled away. 6. It would be apt to indicate here that injuries in the incident were sustained by Ram Roop, Rampher, Jaiprakash, Ram Dularey, Uma Shankar, Ram Sukh and Nankau. 7. After completion of investigation and submission of charge sheet, the Magistrate concerned took cognizance and thereafter said case was committed to the Court of Sessions where it was registered as S.T. No. 360 of 1991 and charges were framed against the accused-appellants under Sections 147, 307 read with Sections 149, 323 read with Section 149 IPC and against Shiv Mohan under Sections 148, 307 read with Section 149 and 324 read with Section 149 IPC. The accused-appellants denied the charges and claimed trial. 8.
